title: Formal Resurgence and Differential Transcendence in Lean 4 (stokes-vandermonde)
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Borel–Stokes–Vandermonde criterion and machine-checked proofs of differential transcendence, spectral positivity, and parity dichotomies across analytic number theory, spectral geometry, combinatorics, special functions, and mathematical physics. Version 3.5.0 adds Waves 8, 9, and 10 (14,643 new lines across 10 modules under PakStokesAllD / PakStokes/AllD/, importing 36 unmodified base modules vendored from companion repository jounih/pak-cubic-theta@6a1cfe5a): (1) Wave 8 (All-d Marked-Wave Engine & Cubic Waring/Dilations): unconditional Besicovitch radical independence for all r >= 2, unconditional critical-value-free LHP theorem for P_d(w) = w^d - dw + (d - 1), extreme-ray projection & generalized domain Marked Jacobian, unconditional differential transcendence of all cubic Waring powers Theta_3(q)^k (k >= 1) and joint differential independence of all finite distinct positive-integer cubic dilations {Theta_3(q^{a_i})} over C(q), plus AllDStokesProfile-parameterized all-d (d >= 3) master theorems (non-vacuous at d = 3 via stokesProfileThree); (2) Wave 9 (Partitions into Squares P_2(q) & All-d Power Partitions): 100% unconditional from Mathlib closed-form Poisson-summation / cotangent-residue identity at d = 2, proving with zero external hypotheses that partitions into squares P_2(q) = prod_{n >= 1} (1 - q^{n^2})^{-1}, every nonzero integer power P_2(q)^k, and every finite family of distinct positive-integer dilations {P_2(q^{a_i})} are differentially transcendental / jointly differentially independent over C(q), plus unconditional all-d >= 2 Kolchin/Vandermonde infrastructure and PowerPartStokesProfile-parameterized d >= 3 master theorems; and (3) Wave 10 (Jump-Point Multivariate Transseries Engine): 100% unconditional algebraic derivation engine on Hahn transseries (jumpPoints_exist, monoidDeriv, hahnDeriv, jumpPoint_minimal_relation_vandermonde, wulffRay_infinite_qrank, multivariate_jumpPoint_non_ade_over_poly) with concrete diagonal-form non-vacuity witnesses diagForm_transseries_non_ade and diagQuartic2D_non_ade (connecting the formal transseries engine to a specific analytic multivariate heat trace still requires the analytic hypothesis). All 248 audited declarations across Waves 1-10 depend strictly on standard Lean axioms ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] or subsets thereof) and pass independent leanchecker --fresh replay. Prime-number-theorem inputs use MediumPNT from PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (PNT+) by Alex Kontorovich, Terence Tao, and contributors. Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude assisted with exploration, auditing, drafting, and Lean formalization.
